{{Quote|Next up, a discontinued ''Hydra Mark VI pod system'', previously ''banned'' by the ''Galactic Republic'' due to its rather generous ''overkill'' feature.|[[Clawfish]]|<ref name="Under the Hammer" />}}
The '''Hydra Mark VI pod system''' was a ground vehicle. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was banned by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] due to its rather generous overkill feature. In around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a Hydra Mark VI pod system was owned by [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] [[Clawfish]], who sold it to the highest bidder in his [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Clawfish Roaming Auction of Illicit and Illegal Weaponry|operation]] on [[Callos]].
